title: Incident severity matrix
excerpt: Severity-1 pages on-call and Internal Comms within 15 minutes. Atlas posts the customer-facing note from the Engineering space, not Slack.
body: Use this matrix whenever a service degrades. Severity-1 means customer impact now: page on-call and Internal Comms within 15 minutes. Severity-2 is degraded but workaround exists. Severity-3 is contained to a single squad. Never announce from a personal channel — publish the note in the Engineering space so Atlas can fan it out.

title: Parental leave: how to start the packet
excerpt: Open the People space, choose Parental leave, and submit 30 days before the planned start. Managers get a calendar hold automatically.
body: Open Atlas → People → Parental leave. Submit the packet at least 30 days before the planned start date. People Ops confirms coverage with your manager and pins a calendar hold. International hires use the same form; the policy page lists country addenda.

title: Data retention FAQ for managers
excerpt: Customer logs are retained for 18 months unless a hold is active. Do not promise deletion dates in email — point to this page.
body: Customer logs stay for 18 months unless Legal places a hold. Managers should not promise a deletion date in email. Link this FAQ instead. If a customer asks for erasure, file the request from the Legal space so counsel can confirm scope.

title: Enterprise pricing playbook
excerpt: Discount floors live here, not in a spreadsheet. Anything below floor needs Finance plus GTM lead sign-off before the proposal leaves Atlas.
body: Discount floors live on this page. Do not keep a side spreadsheet. Anything below floor needs Finance and the GTM lead before the proposal is sent. Launch pricing for new SKUs is drafted in GTM and mirrored to Finance after close.

title: Expense policy 2026
excerpt: Meals $75 / person. Travel books through the company desk. File within 14 days or the report returns to draft.
body: Meals cap at $75 per person unless a VP pre-approves. Book travel through the company desk. File the report within 14 days of the trip or Atlas returns it to draft. Alcohol is not reimbursable except for approved customer dinners logged in GTM.

title: Laptop encryption standard
excerpt: FileVault or BitLocker is required before the device joins the intranet. Lost devices are wiped from the Security space.
body: FileVault or BitLocker must be on before a laptop joins Atlas. Lost or stolen devices are wiped from the Security space — do not wait for a ticket. Contractors use the same standard; People issues the device, Security confirms encryption.

title: On-call handoff template
excerpt: Paste the handoff into the Engineering space before Friday 4pm. Include open Sev-2s and the Atlas article you will keep current.
body: Paste the handoff into Engineering before Friday 4pm local. List open Sev-2s, the Atlas article you will keep current, and who owns customer comms. Internal Comms reads this page first if something pages over the weekend.

title: Referral bonus — how it pays
excerpt: Draft: $4,000 after 90 days on the team. Finance still confirming tax treatment for APAC.
body: Draft awaiting Finance. Proposed: $4,000 after the hire completes 90 days. APAC tax treatment is not confirmed. Do not quote this number to candidates until the page is Published.

title: Vendor DPA checklist
excerpt: Start from Legal → Vendors. Attach the DPA before Procurement can issue a PO. Security reviews data maps in the same packet.
body: Start in Legal → Vendors. Attach the DPA before Procurement issues a PO. Security reviews the data map in the same packet. If the vendor stores logs, link the Data retention FAQ so the 18-month window is explicit.

title: Competitive battlecard — Northwind
excerpt: Last priced against Northwind in February. Refresh before Q4 enterprise deals — pricing floor on this card is out of date.
body: This card last priced Northwind in February. The floor on the page is older than the Enterprise pricing playbook. Refresh before Q4 enterprise deals. Do not send this card to a customer as-is.

title: Close calendar — September
excerpt: Books lock Sep 8. Expense reports after that date post to October. Atlas will freeze draft finance pages at 5pm PT.
body: Books lock September 8. Expense reports filed after that date post to October. Atlas freezes draft Finance pages at 5pm PT on lock day. GTM must have launch accruals in by Sep 6.

title: Report a phishing email
excerpt: Forward to security@, then mark unread in Atlas so Internal Comms can warn the company from this space — not a reply-all.
body: Forward the message to security@ without clicking links. Then mark this how-to unread so Internal Comms can warn the company from the Security space. Do not reply-all. If you already clicked, stay on the call with Security.
